regression_scope: 239 syntax-error fixtures (default batched invalid-test path) and 5 incremental compiler regressions, all using four parser workers and ordinary serial specialization.
integration_scope: 19-file program: 21 LLVM/output equality checks across 0/1/4 workers with function edits, class-layout edits, file removal/reinsertion, environment-only update, source-position shifts; 3 combined exact syntax diagnostic/error recovery/parser-mode reconfiguration records.

benchmark_scope: Fresh processes, fixed 108-file compiler/arparser/cli workload, --check; no --init, specialization, code generation or linking. Identical compiler/stdlib/input hashes. Three trials per 0/4-worker mode, order 0/4,4/0,0/4. No concurrent builds/tests.
configuration: --parser-workers 0 (default ordinary serial map), 1 (serial prepared path), 2..64 (worker limit), auto (available CPU count from nproc capped at 64). Benchmarks use at most 4. Parser worker mode changes rebuild the persistent compiler cache.
auto_worker_affinity_check: With CPU affinity restricted to cores 0,1, --parser-workers auto produced exactly two worker completions.
